description: Defines a helper class 'dl_ssb_pdu_builder' for constructing and setting parameters of 'dl_ssb_pdu' objects related to 5G NR SSB PDU configuration, including carrier, cell, power, SSB parameters, and BCH payload.

classes.name: dl_ssb_pdu_builder
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate setting various parameters of a DL SSB PDU in 5G NR.

methods.name: set_carrier_parameters
methods.description: Sets the subcarrier spacing for the SSB/PBCH PDU.

methods.name: set_cell_parameters
methods.description: Sets the physical cell ID for the SSB/PBCH PDU.

methods.name: set_power_parameters
methods.description: Sets the power profile for the SSB/PBCH PDU.

methods.name: set_ssb_parameters
methods.description: Sets specific SSB parameters including block index, subcarrier offset, point A offset, pattern case, and L_max.

methods.name: set_bch_payload_phy_timing_info
methods.description: Sets the BCH payload with PHY timing info, ensuring value is within bounds.
